Abnormal heat continues to threaten many parts of northern and eastern Africa, Hispaniola, Central America, and northern South America. Drought is expanding in parts of Central America. South Africa sees flooding. **Africa Weather Hazards** Abnormal heat is expected in North and Eastern Africa, while heavy rainfall and flood risks are predicted in West and Southern Africa. 1\) The Sudd wetlands of South Sudan continue to experience inundation. 2\) Severe rainfall deficits across large parts of East Africa over the past 90 days have led to abnormal dryness.
